name: Pharaoh
summary: The king of Egypt whose troubling dreams Joseph explained. He made Joseph ruler over Egypt and welcomed Jacob's family to live in Goshen.

key_moments.title: Troubled by Two Dreams
key_moments.description: Pharaoh dreamed of seven thin cows eating seven fat ones, then of thin ears of grain swallowing full ones. None of the wise men of Egypt could tell him what the dreams meant.

key_moments.title: Sets Joseph over Egypt
key_moments.description: Pharaoh saw that God's Spirit was in Joseph. He gave Joseph his ring and a gold chain and made him ruler of all Egypt, second only to the throne.

key_moments.title: Blessed by Jacob
key_moments.description: Pharaoh told Joseph to settle his father and brothers in the finest part of Egypt, in Goshen. Jacob stood before Pharaoh and blessed him.
